title: The Fourth, 2005 · the lot
logline: Two days after: the Datsun in the hospital lot in Newport at noon, the blue-lit sign, Wood in the cab not getting out, the dog in the bed. The strip has drawn this lot in December. It draws it in July and says nothing new.

panels.composition: A hospital parking lot at noon, a blue-lit sign the strip doesn't letter, the orange Datsun small among the cars.
